en: It is evident from what has been said so far what is at stake in the dialectic against the beginning of the world, and also against its perishing, by which the eternity of matter was to be proved, i.e. the dialectic against becoming, coming-to-be or perishing in general.
– The Kantian antinomy concerning the finitude or infinity of the world in space and time will be examined more closely below at the concept of quantitative infinity.
– That simple, ordinary dialectic rests on maintaining the opposition between being and nothing.
It is proved in the following way that no beginning of the world or of something is possible:
zh: 由以上所述可见，那针对世界开端乃至针对世界消亡（借之原应证明物质的永恒）的辩证法究竟有何种情势，也就是那针对生成、产生或消逝本身的辩证法究竟有何种情势。
——康德关于空间与时间中的世界之有限性或无限性的二律背反，将在下面论及量的无限性这一概念时得到更仔细的考察。
——那种简单的普通辩证法，是建立在坚持存在与无之对立上面的。
以下将这样证明：世界或某物都不可能有开端：

en: Nothing can begin, neither insofar as something is, nor insofar as it is not; for insofar as it is, it does not begin in the first place; but insofar as it is not, it does not begin either.

– If the world or something were to have begun, it would have begun in nothing; but in nothing, or nothing is, there is no beginning; for a beginning includes a being within itself, but nothing contains no being.
Nothing is only nothing.
In a ground, a cause etc., if nothing is determined in this way, an affirmation, a being, is contained.
– For the same reason something too cannot cease.
For being would then have to contain nothing; but being is only being, not the opposite of itself.
zh: 没有什么东西能够开始：无论就其为存在而言，还是就其非存在而言；因为就其为存在而言，它根本不是才开始；而就其非存在而言，它同样不是开始。
——如果世界或某物曾经有过开端，那么它就是在无中开始的；但在无中，或者说无并不是开端；因为开端本身包含着存在，而无则不包含任何存在。
无只是无。
在根据、原因等等之中，如果无是这样被规定的，那么其中就包含着一个肯定、一个存在。
——出于同样的理由，某物同样不能消逝。
因为这样一来存在就必定包含着无；但存在只是存在，而不是它自身的对立面。

en: It is evident that here, against becoming, or beginning and ceasing, this unity of being and nothing, nothing is brought forward except to deny it assertorily and to ascribe truth to being and nothing, each separated from the other.
– This dialectic, however, is at least more consistent than reflecting representation.

For it, it counts as perfect truth that being and nothing are only separated; on the other hand, however, it allows a beginning and a ceasing to count as equally true determinations; but in these it in fact accepts the inseparability of being and nothing.
zh: 由此显然可见：在这里，针对生成、亦即针对开始与停止而提出的存在与无的这一统一，除了以断言的方式否认它、并把真理赋予那彼此分离的存在与无之外，没有提出任何别的东西。
——然而这种辩证法至少比反思性的表象更合乎一贯。
对它来说，存在与无只是彼此分离的，这才算作完满的真理；但另一方面，它又容许一个开始与一个停止作为同样真实的规定而成立；而在这两者中，它事实上接受了存在与无的不可分离性。

en: If one assumes the absolute distinctness of being from nothing, then – as one so often hears – the beginning or becoming is indeed something incomprehensible; for one makes an assumption which cancels the beginning or becoming that one nevertheless admits, and this contradiction, which one poses oneself and whose resolution one makes impossible, is what is called the incomprehensible.
zh: 如果人们预设存在与无的绝对分离——这是人们如此经常听到的——那么开端或生成确实就是某种不可理解的东西；因为人们作出了一个前提，这个前提取消了自己却又承认的开端或生成；而这个由人们自己设定、并且被人们弄得无法解决的矛盾，就叫做不可理解的东西。

en: What has been cited is also the same dialectic that the understanding needs against the concept, the concept which the higher analysis of infinitely small magnitudes provides.
This concept is treated more exhaustively further below.
– These magnitudes have been determined as such as are in their vanishing, not before their vanishing, for then they are finite magnitudes, – nor after their vanishing, for then they are nothing.

Against this pure concept it has been objected, and repeatedly objected, that such magnitudes are either something or nothing; that there is no intermediate state (state is here an inappropriate, barbaric expression) between being and non-being.
– Here too the absolute separation of being and nothing is assumed.

Against this, however, it has been shown that being and nothing are in fact the same, or, to speak in that language, that there is nothing at all which is not an intermediate state between being and nothing.
Mathematics owes its most brilliant successes to the assumption of that determination against which the understanding protests.
zh: 上面所援引的也正是知性对概念的那种需要，即由对无限小的量所作的更高分析给出的概念。
下面将对这个概念作更详尽的论述。
——这些量被规定为：正处于其消失之中，而不是在其消失之前，因为那时它们是有限的量；也不是在其消失之后，因为那时它们就是无。
有人针对这个纯粹的概念提出异议，并且一再重复这种异议：这样的量要么是某物，要么是无；说在存在与非存在之间根本没有任何中间状态（「状态」在这里是一个不恰当的、野蛮的表述）。
——在这里同样预设了存在与无的绝对分离。
但与此相对，人们已经证明：存在与无事实上是同一个东西；或者用那种语言来说：根本不存在任何不是处于存在与无之间的中间状态的东西。
数学之所以取得最辉煌的成就，应归功于那个知性所反对的规定。

en: The reasoning cited above, which makes the false assumption of the absolute separation of being and non-being and stays with it, is not to be called dialectic but sophistry.

For sophistry is a reasoning from a groundless assumption which one lets stand without criticism and thoughtlessly; but dialectic we call the higher rational movement in which such things as appear simply separated pass into one another through themselves, through what they are, and thereby sublate the assumption [of their separateness].
It is the dialectical immanent nature of being and nothing themselves that they show their unity, becoming, as their truth.
zh: 上面所援引的那种推论，它作出了存在与非存在绝对分离这一错误前提并止步于此，这种推论不该称作辩证法，而该称作诡辩。
因为诡辩就是从一个毫无根据的前提出发的推论，人们不加批判、不假思索地让这个前提成立；而辩证法我们称之为那种更高的理性运动：那些显得完全分离的东西，凭自身、凭它们之所是而彼此过渡，并由此扬弃了[它们之分离的]这一前提。
存在与无本身的辩证的内在本性就在于此：它们把它们的统一、生成显示为它们的真理。

en: Becoming, coming-to-be and perishing, is the inseparability of being and nothing; not the unity which is abstracted from being and nothing, but as the unity of being and nothing it is this determinate unity, or [the unity] in which both being and nothing are.
But insofar as being and nothing are each undivided from the other, it is not that abstract unity.
They are therefore in this unity, but as vanishing ones, only as sublated ones.
They sink from their initially presupposed self-sufficiency down to moments, still distinct, but at the same time sublated.
zh: 生成、产生与消逝，是存在与无的不可分离性；它不是那种从存在与无中抽象出来的统一，而是作为存在与无的统一，它是这一有规定的统一，即那存在与无都在其中的统一。
但是，由于存在与无各自都与对方不可分离，它并不是那种从存在与无中抽象出来的统一。
因此它们是在这一统一之中，但作为正在消失者，它们只是作为被扬弃者。
它们从最初被表象的独立自主沉降为一些环节，这些环节仍然彼此有别，但同时又是被扬弃的。

en: If they are taken up in this their inequality, each one is in it the unity with the other.

Becoming thus contains being and nothing as two such unities, each of which is itself the unity of being and nothing; the one, being as immediate and as relation to the nothing; the other, the nothing as immediate and as relation to the being: the determinations are of unequal value in these unities.
zh: 如果按它们这种差别来把握它们，那么每一个在这一差别中就是与另一个的统一。
于是生成把存在与无包含为两个这样的统一，每一个本身都是存在与无的统一；其一，存在作为直接者并作为对无的关系；其二，无作为直接者并作为对存在的关系：这些规定在这两个统一中具有不等的价值。

en: Becoming is in this way twofold determinate; in the one the nothing is the immediate, i.e. it is beginning from the nothing, which relates itself to the being, i.e. passes over into it; in the other the being is the immediate, i.e. it is beginning from the being, which passes over into the nothing,
– coming-to-be and perishing.
zh: 生成由此具有双重的规定；在一个规定中，无是直接者，即它是从无开始的，而这个无又关联于存在，即过渡到存在；在另一个规定中，存在是直接者，即它是从存在开始的，而存在又过渡到无，
——产生与消逝。

en: Both are the same, becoming, and even as these so different directions they penetrate and paralyse each other mutually.
The one is perishing; being passes over into nothing, but nothing is just as much the opposite of itself, a passing over into being, a coming-to-be.
This coming-to-be is the other direction; nothing passes over into being, but being equally sublates itself and is rather the passing over into nothing, is perishing.
– They do not sublate each other, not the one outwardly the other, but each sublates itself in itself and is in itself the opposite of itself.
zh: 两者是同一个东西，即生成；而且即便作为这样彼此相异的两个方向，它们也相互渗透、彼此抵消。
其一是消逝：存在过渡到无，但无同样也是它自身的对立面，即过渡到存在、产生。
这种产生是另一个方向：无过渡到存在，但存在同样扬弃自身，而且毋宁说就是过渡到无、就是消逝。
——它们并不是彼此扬弃的，不是这一个外在地扬弃那一个，而是每一个都在自身中扬弃自身，并且在它自身上就是它自身的对立面。

en: The balance into which coming-to-be and perishing set themselves is at first becoming itself.
But this too collapses into quiet unity.
Being and nothing are in it only as vanishing ones; but becoming as such is only through the inequality of the two.
Their vanishing is therefore the vanishing of becoming, or the vanishing of vanishing itself.
Becoming is an unsteady unrest which collapses into a quiet result.
zh: 产生与消逝相互抵消而达到的那个平衡，首先就是生成本身。
但这个平衡同样也归结为平静的统一。
存在与无在其中只是作为正在消失者；但生成作为生成，只是通过二者的差别才得以成立。
所以它们的消失就是生成的消失，或者说，是消失本身的消失。
生成是一种无所依凭的不安，它归结为一个平静的结果。

en: This could also be expressed as follows: becoming is the vanishing of being into nothing and of nothing into being, and the vanishing of being and nothing in general; but at the same time it rests on the difference between them.
It therefore contradicts itself in itself, because it unites in itself such things as are opposed to one another; but such a union destroys itself.
zh: 这也可以这样表述：生成是存在向无的消失和无向存在的消失，并且是存在与无的消失；但同时它又以二者的差别为基础。
因此它就自身而言是自相矛盾的，因为它把彼此对立的东西统一在自身之中；而这样的统一会自行毁灭。

en: This result is the state of having vanished, but not as nothing; for then it would only be a relapse into one of the determinations already sublated, and not the result of nothing and being.
It is the unity of being and nothing that has become quiet simplicity.
But this quiet simplicity is being, though no longer being for itself, but as the determination of the whole.
zh: 这个结果乃是已消失的状态，但并不是作为无；否则它就不过是退回到那些已经被扬弃的规定之一，而并不是无与存在的结果。
它是那种已成为平静的简单性的存在与无的统一。
但这种平静的简单性就是存在，尽管它不再是自为的存在，而是作为整体的规定。

en: Becoming, as the passing over into the unity of being and nothing, which is as being or which has the shape of the one-sided immediate unity of these moments, is determinate being.
zh: 生成，作为过渡到存在与无的统一，而这一统一是作为存在着的，或者说具有这些环节的单方面的直接统一的形态，就是定在。

en: Sublation and the sublated (the ideal) is one of the most important concepts of philosophy, a fundamental determination which recurs everywhere, whose sense must be apprehended definitively and which must especially be distinguished from nothing.
– What is sublated does not thereby become nothing.

Nothing is the immediate; a sublated thing, on the contrary, is a mediated thing: it is the non-existent, but as a result which has proceeded from a being; it therefore still has in itself the determinateness from which it comes.
zh: 扬弃与被扬弃者（观念物），是哲学中最重要的概念之一，是一项到处都在反复出现的基本规定；它的意义必须确切地加以把握，并且特别要把它与无区别开来。
——被扬弃的东西并不因此就成为无。
无是直接者；反之，被扬弃者是一个被中介者：它是非存在者，但作为一个从存在中产生出来的结果；因此它自身仍然带有它所由来的那种规定性。

en: Sublation has in the language a double sense: it means as much as to preserve, to keep, and at the same time as much as to put an end to, to make an end.

Preservation itself already includes the negative in itself, namely that something is taken away from its immediacy, and thereby from a determinate being open to external influences, in order to preserve it.
– Thus the sublated is at the same time the preserved, which has only lost its immediacy, but is not on that account annihilated.
– The two determinations of sublation just given can be listed in the lexicon as two meanings of this word.
It would, however, have to seem striking in this connection that a language has come to use one and the same word for two opposed determinations.
For speculative thinking it is a pleasure to find in the language words which have a speculative meaning in themselves; the German language has several such words.
The double sense of the Latin tollere (which became famous through the Ciceronian joke »tollendum esse Octavium«) does not go so far; the affirmative determination only reaches as far as lifting up.
Something is sublated only insofar as it has entered into unity with its opposite; in this more proximate determination as a reflected thing it can appropriately be called a moment.

Weight and distance from a point are called the mechanical moments of a lever, because of the sameness of their effect despite all the other difference between a real thing, such as a weight, and an ideal thing, the mere spatial determination, the line; see the Encyclopedia of the Philosophical Sciences, 3.

edition, § 261 remark. – Still more often the observation will press itself upon us that philosophical art-language uses Latin expressions for reflected determinations, either because the mother tongue has no expressions for them, or, if it has them as here, because its expression reminds us more of the immediate, whereas the foreign language reminds us more of the reflected.
zh: 扬弃在语言中有双重的意义：它既意味着保存、保有，同时又意味着使之终止、终结。
保存本身就已经把否定包含在自身之中，即：某物被从它的直接性中、从那种向外在作用敞开的定在中夺取出来，以便保存它。
——因此，被扬弃者同时就是被保存者，它只是失去了自己的直接性，但并不因此就被毁灭。
——上面指出的扬弃的两个规定，可以在词典中列为这个词的两种词义。
但在这里，一个民族的语言竟用同一个词来表达两个相对的规定，这一点必然显得引人注目。
对于思辨的思维来说，在语言中能找到一些本身就带有思辨意义的词，是一件令人欣慰的事；德语中就有好几个这样的词。
拉丁文 tollere 的双义（它因西塞罗式的俏皮话「tollendum esse Octavium」而出了名）并没有走得这么远；肯定的规定只达到提升这一步。
某物只有当它进入了与它的对立者的统一之中时，才是被扬弃了的；在这一更切近的规定中，作为一个被反思者，它恰当地可以叫做环节。
重量和到一点的距离被称为杠杆的机械力矩，因为尽管一个实在物（例如一个重量）与一个观念物（纯粹空间的规定，即直线）之间另有其他一切相异，这两个量的效果却是同一的；参见《哲学百科全书》，3.
版，§ 261 注。——更常会使我们产生这样的想法：哲学的术语语言对被反思的规定使用拉丁文表达，或者是因为母语没有相应的表达，或者（像这里这样）是因为母语的表达更多地使人联想到直接者，而外国语的表达则更多地使人联想到被反思者。

en: The more proximate sense and expression which being and nothing, now that they are moments, receive, is to emerge in the consideration of determinate being as the unity in which they are preserved.
Being is being and nothing is nothing only in their inequality from one another; but in their truth, in their unity, they have vanished as these determinations and are now something else.

Being and nothing are the same; precisely because they are the same, they are no longer being and nothing and have a different determination; in becoming they were coming-to-be and perishing; in determinate being as a differently determined unity they are again differently determined moments.
This unity now remains their ground, from which they no longer step out into the abstract meaning of being and nothing.
zh: 存在与无现在既然成了环节，它们所获得的那更切近的意义与表达，就要在把定在看作那保存着它们的统一时显现出来。
存在只是存在、无只是无，这只在它们彼此的差别中才成立；但在它们的真理中、在它们的统一中，它们作为这些规定已经消失，如今是别的东西了。
存在与无是同一个东西；正因为它们是同一个东西，它们才不再是存在与无，而获得了一个不同的规定；在生成中它们是产生与消逝；在定在、即在那个另样地规定着的统一中，它们又是另样地规定着的环节。
这一统一现在便成了它们的根据，它们不再从这一根据中走出去而进入存在与无的抽象意义。

en: Determinate being is determinate being; its determinateness is being determinateness, quality.
Through its quality something is determinate against an other, is changeable and finite, not only against an other but in itself simply negatively determinate.

This negation of its, which is at first opposed to the finite something, is the infinite, the abstract opposition in which these determinations appear; it resolves itself into the oppositionless infinity, into being-for-itself.
The treatment of determinate being has thus the three divisions:
zh: 定在是规定了的存在；它的规定性是存在着的规定性，即质。
通过它的质，某物是相对于一个他者而规定的，是可变的和有限的；它不仅相对于一个他者，而且就其自身而言是纯粹地否定地规定的。
这种首先与有限的某物相对立的否定，就是无限者，就是这些规定得以显现的那个抽象的对立；它消解于无对立者的无限性之中，消解于自为存在之中。
于是，对定在的论述分为三个部分：

en: A. determinate being as such,
zh: A. 定在本身，

en: B. something and other, finitude,
zh: B. 某物与他者，有限性，

en: C. qualitative infinity.
zh: C. 质的无限性。

en: On determinate being
zh: 论定在

en: a) as such, its determinateness is at first to be distinguished
zh: a) 就定在本身而言，首先应当区分出它的规定性

en: b) from quality.
This, however, is to be taken both in the one and in the other determination of determinate being, as reality and as negation.
But in these determinatenesses determinate being is just as much reflected into itself; and as such posited it is
zh: b) 与质。
但这一规定性既要在定在的一种规定中、也要在它的另一种规定中来把握：作为实在性，也作为否定。
但在这些规定性中，定在同样地向自身反思；而作为这样被设定的东西，它是

en: c) something, that which is determinate.
zh: c) 某物，存在者。

en: From becoming determinate being emerges.
Determinate being is the simple being-one of being and nothing.
For the sake of this simplicity it has the form of an immediate.
Its mediation, becoming, lies behind it; it has sublated itself, and determinate being therefore appears as a first, from which one starts.
It is at first in the one-sided determination of being; the other which it contains, the nothing, will also emerge in it, against that one.
zh: 定在从生成中产生出来。
定在是存在与无的简单合而为一。
由于这种简单性，它具有一个直接者的形式。
它的中介，即生成，处于它之后；这一中介已经把自身扬弃了，因此定在显现为一个第一者，人们便是从它出发。
它首先处在存在的单方面规定中；它所包含的另一个规定，即无，也将同样在它身上显现出来，与前一个规定相对。

en: It is not mere being, but determinate being; taken etymologically: being at a certain place, but the representation of space does not belong here.
Determinate being is, according to its becoming, in general being with a non-being, so that this non-being is taken up into simple unity with the being.
The non-being thus taken up into the being, so that the concrete whole is in the form of being, of immediacy, constitutes the determinateness as such.
zh: 它不只是单纯的存在，而是定在；从词源上说，是处在某个地点的存在，但关于空间的表象不属于这里。
定在就其生成而言，总归是存在与一个非存在；这个非存在被吸收到与存在的简单统一之中。
这样被吸收进存在的非存在——使具体的整体处在存在的形式、处在直接性的形式中——构成了规定性本身。

en: The whole is likewise in the form, i.e. determinateness, of being – for being has likewise shown itself in becoming to be only a moment – a sublated, negatively determinate one; but thus it is for us in our reflection, not yet posited in itself.
But the determinateness of determinate being as such is the posited determinateness which also lies in the expression »Dasein«.
– The two must always be well distinguished from one another; what is merely posited in a concept belongs to the developing consideration of that concept, to its content.

The determinateness not yet posited in itself, however, belongs to our reflection, whether it concerns the nature of the concept itself or is an external comparison; to single out a determinateness of the latter kind can only serve to elucidate or anticipate the course which will manifest itself in the development itself.

That the whole, the unity of being and nothing, is in the one-sided determinateness of being is an external reflection; but in the negation, in the something and the other etc., it will come to that, to be posited.

– It was intended here to call attention to the difference indicated; but to give an account of everything which reflection may permit itself to observe would lead to prolixity, [in that it would] anticipate what must emerge from the thing itself.

If such reflections can serve to facilitate the overview and thereby the understanding, they also bring along the disadvantage of looking like unwarranted assertions, reasons and grounds for what follows.
One should therefore take them for nothing more than what they are, and distinguish them from what is a moment in the progress of the thing itself.
zh: 整体同样处在存在的形式、亦即规定性的形式中——因为存在在生成中同样表明自己只是一个环节——一个被扬弃的、否定地规定着的环节；但在我们反思中它是这样，对它自身而言则还没有被设定。
但定在本身的规定性就是那个被设定的规定性，它也包含在「定在」这一表述之中。
——这两者始终应当好好地区别开来；仅仅被设定在一个概念之中的东西，属于对这一概念加以展开的考察，属于它的内容。
但那尚未在它自身上被设定的规定性属于我们的反思，无论它涉及概念本身的性质，还是一种外在的比较；单挑出后一类规定性，只能有助于说明或预先提示那条将在展开本身中显现出来的进程。
说整体、说存在与无的统一处在存在的单方面规定性之中，这乃是一种外在的反思；但在否定中、在某物与他者等等之中，它将进而被设定。
——这里本是要提请注意上面所指出的差别；但若要把反思所能允许自己观察到的一切都加以说明，就会流于啰嗦，因为那会预先臆断出必须由事情本身产生出来的东西。
如果这类反思能够有助于总览、从而有助于理解，那么它们也会带来这样的缺点：它们看上去像是为接下来的一切提供了未经正当的断言、理由和根据。
因此，人们对它们不应有超出它们实际所是的任何更高的期待，并且应当把它们同事情本身的进程中的一个环节区别开来。

en: Determinate being corresponds to the being of the preceding sphere; being, however, is the undetermined, and therefore no determinations accrue to it.
But determinate being is a determinate being, a concrete one; thus several determinations, distinct relations of its moments, at once disclose themselves in it.
zh: 定在与前一领域的存在相对应；但存在是不规定的，因此并没有任何规定归属于它。
但定在是一个被规定了的存在，一个具体的存在；因此，若干规定、它的环节之间的种种有别的关系，随即就在它身上显露出来。

en: For the sake of the immediacy in which being and nothing are one in determinate being, they do not pass over into one another; insofar as determinate being is being, so far it is non-being, it is determinate.
Being is not the universal, determinateness not the particular.

Determinateness has not yet detached itself from being; though it will also no longer detach itself from it, for the true which now lies at the foundation is the unity of non-being with the being; on it, as the ground, all further determinations follow.
But the relation in which determinateness here stands to being is the immediate unity of both, so that no distinction of them is yet posited.
zh: 为了定在之中存在与无合而为一的那种直接性，它们彼此并不过渡；定在在多少是存在的地方，它就在多少是非存在，它就是被规定的。
存在不是普遍者，规定性也不是特殊者。
规定性还没有从存在中分离出来；不过它也将不再从存在中分离出来，因为如今作为根据而立于那里的真理，是非存在与存在的统一；在它、即在这个根据之上，一切更远的规定都随之产生。
但规定性在这里与存在所处的关系，是两者的直接统一，因此还没有设定它们之间的任何区分。

en: Determinateness isolated for itself, as being determinateness, is quality, – a wholly simple, immediate thing.
Determinateness in general is the more universal, which can just as well be the quantitative as something more determinate.
For the sake of this simplicity there is nothing further to say about quality as such.
zh: 规定性如果就其本身被孤立出来、作为存在的规定性，就是质——一个完全单纯、直接的东西。
规定性一般说来是较为普遍者，它同样可以是量的，也可以是更进一步被规定的东西。
由于这种简单性，对于质本身就不必再说什么了。

en: But determinate being, in which nothing as much as being is contained, is itself the standard for the one-sidedness of quality as merely immediate or being determinateness.

It is equally to be posited in the determination of nothing, whereby the immediate or the being determinateness is posited as a distinct, reflected one; the nothing as the determinate of a determinateness is equally a reflected thing, a negation.

Quality, so that it counts as being when distinguished, is reality; it, as being affected by a negation, negation in general, is equally a quality, but one which counts as a lack and further determines itself as limit, boundary.
zh: 但定在——其中无与存在同样都被包含着——本身就是质作为仅仅直接的、存在着的规定性之片面性的尺度。
它同样要在无的规定中被设定，由此，作为被区别开来的、被反思的规定性，直接的或存在着的规定性被设定；无作为某规定性的规定者，同样是一个被反思者、一个否定。
质在被区别开来而算是存在时，就是实在性；而它作为带有一重否定、作为否定一般，同样是一种质，不过这种质被视为一种匮乏，并进一步把自己规定为界限、限度。

en: Both are a determinate being; but in reality as quality with the accent of being, it is hidden that it contains determinateness, and hence also negation; reality therefore counts only as something positive from which negation, restrictedness and lack are excluded.
The negation taken as mere lack would be what nothing is; but it is a determinate being, a quality, determined only by a non-being.
zh: 两者都是一个定在；但在作为质、并且以存在为重音的实在性中，隐藏着它包含规定性、因而也包含否定这一点；因此实在性只被看作某种肯定的东西，否定、受限性和匮乏都从中被排除出去。
如果把否定仅仅当作匮乏来取，它就正是无；但它是一个定在、一种质，只不过是由一个非存在所规定的。

en: Reality can seem to be a very ambiguous word, because it is used with various, indeed opposed determinations.
In the philosophical sense one speaks, for example, of mere empirical reality as of a worthless determinate being.

But when it is said of thoughts, concepts, theories that they have no reality, this means that no actuality accrues to them; the idea of a Platonic Republic could indeed be true in itself or in the concept.
Here the value of the idea is not denied, and it is left alongside reality as well.
But against so-called mere ideas, against mere concepts, the real counts as the only true.

– The sense in which once the decision about the truth of a content is attributed to external determinate being is just as one-sided as when the idea, the essence or even the inner feeling is imagined as indifferent towards external determinate being, and is even considered all the more excellent the further it is removed from reality.
zh: 实在性这个词似乎可以有多义性，因为它被用于各种不同的、甚至相互对立的规定。
在哲学的意义上，人们例如把单纯经验意义上的实在性说成一种毫无价值的定在。
但如果说思想、概念、理论没有实在性，这意思是说它们没有现实性；比如柏拉图《理想国》的观念，就其自身或在概念而言确实可能是真的。
这里并没有否认该观念的价值，它也仍旧与实在性并列。
但对于所谓单纯的观念、单纯的概念来说，实在物是唯一真实的东西。
——那种把一个内容之真理的裁决权归给外在的定在的意义，是片面的，正如观念、本质、甚至内在的感觉被表象为对外在的定在无关紧要、并且离实在性越远反而越被认为越高尚一样。

en: In connection with the expression »reality« the other metaphysical concept of God, which was chiefly taken as the basis of the so-called ontological proof of the existence of God, is to be mentioned.

God was determined as the aggregate of all realities, and it was said of this aggregate that it contains no contradiction within itself, that none of the realities sublates the other; for a reality is to be taken only as a perfection, as an affirmative which contains no negation.
Thus the realities are not opposed to one another and do not contradict one another.
zh: 在「实在性」这一表述上，还应当提到上帝的那个别的形而上学概念——它主要曾被用作那个所谓的上帝存在的本体论证明的基础。
上帝曾被规定为一切实在性的总汇，并且人们对这个总汇说：它自身不包含任何矛盾，任何一个实在性都不扬弃另一个；因为一个实在性只能被当作一种完善性、当作一种不含任何否定的肯定者来把握。
因此这些实在性彼此并不对立，彼此也并不矛盾。

en: In this concept of reality it is assumed that it would still remain if all negation were thought away; but in doing so, all determinateness of it is sublated.
Reality is quality, determinate being; in that it contains the moment of the negative and is thereby alone the determinate which it is.
Taken in the so-called eminent sense, or as infinite – in the ordinary meaning of the word –, as it is to be taken, it is expanded into the indeterminate and loses its meaning.

The goodness of the Good shall not be goodness in the ordinary sense but in the eminent sense, not different from justice but tempered through it (a Leibnizian expression for mediation), and conversely justice through goodness; thus neither is goodness any longer goodness nor justice any longer justice.

Power is to be tempered through wisdom, but in that way it is not power as such, for it would be subject to it; – wisdom is to be extended into power, but in that way it disappears as the wisdom determining the end and the measure.

The true concept of the infinite and its absolute unity, which will emerge later, is not to be taken as a tempering, a mutual restriction or a mingling, such as is a superficial relation held in indefinite fog, with which only conceptless representing can content itself. – The reality, as it is taken in that definition of God as determinate quality, when carried beyond its determinateness, ceases to be reality; it becomes abstract being; God as the purely real in all the real or as the aggregate of all realities is the same indeterminate and contentless thing as the empty Absolute, in which everything is one.
zh: 在实在性的这一概念中，人们预设：即使把一切否定都撇开，它仍然会保持；但这样一来，它的全部规定性就被扬弃了。
实在性就是质、就是定在；正因如此它才包含着否定的环节，并且唯有凭借这一点，它才是它所是的那个被规定者。
当它在所谓卓越的意义上、或者作为无限者——按这个词的通常含义——被取用时，它就被扩张到无规定之中，从而失去了它的意义。
善的良善不应当是通常意义上的良善，而应当是卓越意义上的良善；它不是与公正不同，而是通过公正来加以调和（这是莱布尼茨式的中介表述），公正同样也通过良善来调和；这样一来，良善就不再是良善，公正也不再是公正。
力量应当通过智慧来加以调和，但这样一来它就不再是作为这样的力量了，因为它会从属于智慧；——智慧则应当被扩展为力量，但这样一来，作为规定目的与尺度的智慧就消失了。

无限者的真正概念及其绝对统一（后者将在后面出现），不可被理解为一种调和、一种相互限制或一种混合——那种关系是表面的、被保持在不确定的迷雾之中的，只有无概念的表象才满足于它。——实在性，在上帝的那一定义中被当作特定的质来取用，一旦被推过它的规定性，它就不再是实在性，而变成抽象的存在；上帝作为一切实在物中纯粹的实在者、或者作为一切实在物的总汇，就是那个与空洞的绝对者、那个其中一切皆为一者相同的既无规定又无内容者。

en: If, on the contrary, reality is taken in its determinateness, then, since it essentially contains the moment of the negative, the aggregate of all realities becomes just as much an aggregate of all negations, the aggregate of all contradictions, approximately at first the absolute power in which everything determinate is absorbed; but since it itself is only insofar as it still has over against it something not sublated by it, it becomes the abstract nothing when it is thought extended into the carried-out, limitless power.
That real in all the real, that being in all determinate being, which is meant to express the concept of God, is nothing other than abstract being, the same thing that nothing is.
zh: 反之，若在规定性中取用实在性，那么，由于它本质上包含着否定的环节，一切实在物的总汇同样也就成为一切否定的总汇、一切矛盾的总汇，起初大致就是那种一切被规定者都被吸收进去的绝对力量；但由于它自身仅仅在它面前还有一个未被它扬弃的东西时才存在，所以当它被思想为扩展为那种贯彻到底的、无界限的力量时，它就成为抽象的无。
那一切实在物中的实在者、那一切定在中的存在——它应当表达上帝的概念——无非就是抽象的存在，与无是同一个东西。

en: Determinateness is negation posited affirmatively, – it is Spinoza’s proposition: Omnis determinatio est negatio.

This proposition is of infinite importance; only the negation as such is the formless abstraction; but the speculative philosophy must not be blamed for holding that for it the negation or the nothing is the ultimate; it is no more the ultimate for it than reality is the true.
zh: 规定性就是被肯定地设定起来的否定，——也就是斯宾诺莎的命题：Omnis determinatio est negatio。
这个命题具有无限的重要性；只是，否定作为这样的否定乃是无形式的抽象；但不能责怪思辨的哲学，认为对它来说否定或无是最后者；对它来说，这并不比实在性是真实者更多。

en: From this proposition, that determinateness is negation, the unity of Spinozistic substance – or that there is only one substance – is the necessary consequence.

Thinking and being or extension, the two determinations which Spinoza has before him, he had to set together into one in this unity; for as determinate realities they are negations, whose infinity is their unity; according to Spinoza’s definition, of which more below, the infinity of something is its affirmation.

He therefore understood them as attributes, i.e. as such as do not have a special existence, a being-in-and-for-self, but are only as sublated ones, as moments; or rather they are not even moments to him, for the substance is that which is entirely indeterminate in itself, and the attributes are, like the modes too, distinctions which an external understanding makes.
– Likewise the substantiality of individuals cannot hold out against that proposition.

The individual is a relation to itself by virtue of its setting limits to everything other; but these limits are thereby also limits of itself, relations to the other; it does not have its determinate being in itself.

The individual is indeed more than merely that which is restricted on all sides, but this more belongs to another sphere of the concept; in the metaphysics of being it is a determinate pure and simple; and that such a thing, that the finite as such is in and for itself, against this the determinateness makes itself essentially valid as negation and tears it into the same negative movement of the understanding which makes everything disappear into the abstract unity, the substance.
zh: 从「规定性是否定」这一命题出发，斯宾诺莎式实体的统一——或者说只有唯一实体——是必然的结果。
思维与存在或广延——斯宾诺莎面前的这两种规定——必须在这一统一中合而为一；因为作为特定的实在性，它们是否定，而它们的无限性就是它们的统一；按照斯宾诺莎的定义（下面还要谈到），某物的无限性就是它的肯定。
因此他把它们理解为属性，即理解为这样一种规定：它们并不具有单独的持存、并不具有自在自为的存在，而只是作为被扬弃者、作为环节而存在；或者更确切地说，它们对他来说甚至不是环节，因为实体正是在自身中彻底无规定的东西，而属性则像样式一样，是外在知性所作的区分。
——同样，个体的实体性也不能与那个命题相抵触。
个体之所以是对自身的关系，是因为它为一切他者设定界限；但这些界限因而也是它自身的界限、是与他者的关系；它并不是在自身之中具有它的定在。
个体固然不只是那在所有方面都受限的东西，但这个「更多」属于概念的另一个领域；在存在的形而上学中，它是一个纯粹被规定者；而说这样一个东西、说有限者作为有限者自在自为地存在，与此相对，规定性本质上就作为否定而生效，并把它拖入知性的那种否定运动之中，这种运动让一切都消失在抽象的统一、实体之中。

en: Negation stands immediately opposed to reality: further on, in the proper sphere of reflected determinations, it is opposed to the positive, which is the reality that reflects on negation, – the reality in which the negative appears, which is still hidden in reality as such.
zh: 否定直接地与实在性相对立：进一步，在被反思的规定的真正领域之中，它与肯定相对立，而那肯定正是那种反思着否定的实在性——否定在其中显现出来，但它在作为这样的实在性中仍然还是隐藏着的。

en: Quality is first of all a property in the respect in which it shows itself as an immanent determination in an external relation.

By properties, e.g. of herbs, one understands determinations which belong to a something not only in general, but inasmuch as it maintains itself thereby in its relation to others in a peculiar way, does not allow the alien influences posited in it to have their way within it, but makes its own determinations valid in the other – even though it does not thereby hold the other off from itself.
The more resting determinatenesses, e.g. figure, shape, one does not indeed call properties, nor even qualities, insofar as they are imagined as changeable, as not identical with being.
zh: 质首先在这样一种关系中才是属性：它在一种外在的关系中显示为内在的规定。
所谓的属性（例如草药的属性）指的是这样一些规定：它们不仅一般地属于某个某物，而且某物正因此才在它对他者的关系中以一种独特的方式保持自身，不容许那些被设定在它之中的外在作用在它内部得逞，而是在他者身上使自己的规定生效——尽管它并不因此就把他者挡在自己之外。
相反，那些较为静止的规定性，例如形状、形态，人们就既不称之为属性、也不称之为质，就其被表象为可变的、与存在并不相同而言。

en: The qualification or disqualification, an expression of Jakob Böhme, of a philosophy that goes into the depth, but into a turbid depth, means the movement of a quality (of the sour, the pungent, the fiery etc.) within itself, insofar as it posits and establishes itself out of the other in its negative nature (in its quality), and is in general the unrest of the quality in itself, by which it only brings itself forth and maintains itself in the struggle.
zh: 质化或去质化——这是雅各布·波墨的表述，那是一种深入到深处、但深入到浑浊之处的哲学——意指一种质（酸的、辛的、火的等等）在其自身中的运动：质就其否定的本性（就其质而言）从他者那里设定并确立自身；而这一般说来就是质在自身中的不安，质只有在斗争中才显现出自己并保持自己。

en: In determinate being its determinateness has been distinguished as quality; in this, as being determinate, the distinction – that of reality and negation – is present.
Now, to the extent that these distinctions are present in determinate being, to that same extent they are also null and sublated.
Reality itself contains the negation, is determinate being, not undetermined, abstract being.
Likewise the negation is determinate being, not the nothing which is supposed to be abstract, but posited here as it is in itself, as being, belonging to determinate being.
Thus quality as such is not separated from determinate being; determinate being is only determinate, qualitative being.
zh: 在定在之中，它的规定性已被区分为质；在这一存在着的规定性中，那个差别——即实在性与否定之间的差别——就在其中。
这些差别在定在中存在得越是如此，它们也同样地是无效的、是被扬弃的。
实在性自身包含着否定，它就是定在，不是未规定的、抽象的存在。
同样，否定也是定在，不是那个据说应当是抽象的无，而是像它自在地所是的那样、作为存在者被设定在这里，属于定在。
因此，质本身就并不与定在分离开来；定在不过是规定了的、质性的存在。

en: This sublation of the distinction is more than a mere taking-back and external letting-go of it, or a simple return to the simple beginning, determinate being as such.
The distinction cannot be left out; for it is.

The actual, what is thus present, is determinate being in general, the distinction in it and the sublation of this distinction; determinate being not as undifferentiated, as at the beginning, but as again equal to itself, the simplicity of determinate being mediated through this sublation.
This being-sublated of the distinction is the own determinateness of determinate being; thus it is being-in-itself; determinate being is determinate being, something.
zh: 这种对差别的扬弃，不只是单纯地把差别收回并外在地撇开，也不只是简单地回到那个单纯的开端，即作为这样的定在。
差别不能被撇开；因为它是有的。
因此，实际存在的东西就是一般的定在、它之中的差别以及对这个差别的扬弃；定在不是像开端时那样作为无差别者，而是作为重新与自身相等者，通过对这个差别的扬弃，定在的单纯性才得到中介。
这种差别的被扬弃状态就是定在自身的规定性；定在是这样一种自身内存在：定在就是存在者、就是某物。

en: Something is the negation of the first negation, as simple being relation to itself.
Determinate being, life, thinking etc. determine themselves essentially to determinate being, the living, the thinking (I) etc.
This determination is of the highest importance, so as not to stop at determinate being, life, thinking etc., nor even at divinity (instead of God) as generalities.
Something is rightly held by representation to be a real thing.

Yet something is still a very superficial determination; like reality and negation, determinate being and its determinateness are indeed no longer the empty ones – being and nothing –, but quite abstract determinations.

That is why they are also the most usual expressions, and philosophically unformed reflection uses them the most, pours its distinctions into them and thinks it has in them something quite good and firmly determined.
– The negative of the negative is, as something, only the beginning of the subject, – the being-in-itself only quite indeterminate as yet.
It further determines itself first as being-for-self and so on, until only in the concept it receives the concrete intensity of the subject.
The negative unity with itself lies at the foundation of all these determinations.

But here the negation as the first, as negation in general, is indeed to be distinguished from the second, the negation of negation, which is the concrete, absolute negativity, whereas that first is only the abstract negativity.
zh: 某物是第一个否定的否定，是作为单纯地存在着的对自身的关系。
定在、生命、思维等等，本质上都规定为存在者、生命者、思维者（我）等等。
这一规定具有最高的重要性，以免停留在定在、生命、思维等等这些普遍者上，甚至停留在神性（而不是上帝）上。
某物被表象恰当地看作一个实在物。
然而，某物仍然是一个非常表面的规定；正如实在性与否定、定在及其规定性虽然不再是那空虚的——存在与无——但也仍然是完全抽象的规定。
因此它们也是最常见的表达方式，未经哲学训练的反思最多地使用它们，把自己的区分灌入其中，并以为自己从中获得了某种相当完善、而且牢固定着的东西。
——否定之否定作为某物只是主体的开端，——而自身内存在此时还完全是不确定的。
它进而首先规定为自为者，如此等等，直到它只有在概念中才获得主体的具体强度。
所有这些规定都以它与自身的否定性统一为基础。
但在这里，否定作为第一个、作为否定一般毕竟应当与第二个、即否定之否定区分开来：后者是具体的、绝对的否定性，而前者则仅仅是抽象的否定性。

en: Something is being as the negation of negation; for this is the restoring of the simple relation to itself; – but equally thereby something is the mediation of itself with itself.

Already in the simplicity of something, then still more determinately in being-for-self, subject etc., the mediation of itself with itself is present, already also in becoming only the quite abstract mediation; the mediation with itself is posited in something insofar as it is determined as the simple identical.

– Against the principle of the alleged mere immediacy of knowledge, from which mediation is supposed to be excluded, the presence of mediation in general may be pointed out; but it need not further be made a point to call attention particularly to the moment of mediation; for it is present everywhere and everywhere, in every concept.
zh: 某物是作为否定之否定而存在的；因为否定之否定就是对那个单纯的对自身关系的恢复；——同样，某物也就是它与自身的中介。
在某物的单纯性中就已经有它与自身的中介，在自为存在、主体等等中就更为确定地有了；即便在生成中，也还只有完全抽象的中介；与自身的中介在某物中被设定，就某物被规定为单纯的同一者而言。
——针对那种断言知识具有单纯直接性、从而要把中介排除在外的原则，可以指出中介一般地是现成存在的；但此外并不需要特别提请人们注意中介的环节；因为它到处都在、在每个概念中。

en: This mediation with itself, which something is in itself, has, taken merely as the negation of negation, no concrete determinations on its sides; thus it collapses into the simple unity which is being.
Something is and is indeed determinate being; it is in itself also becoming, but which no longer has merely being and nothing as its moments.
The one of them, being, is now determinate being and further determinate being.
The second is likewise a determinate being, but determined as the negative of something, – an other.
Something as becoming is a passing over whose moments are themselves something and which is therefore change; – a becoming that has already become concrete.

– But something changes itself to begin with only in its concept; it is not yet posited in that way as mediating and mediated; to begin with only as simply maintaining itself in its relation to itself, and its negative as an equally qualitative, only an other in general.
zh: 这种与自身的中介（某物自在地就是它），如果仅仅作为否定之否定来取，它的两边就没有具体的规定；这样它就归结为那个是存在的单纯统一。
某物是并且确实是存在者；它自在地又是生成，但这个生成不再以存在与无为它的环节。
它们之中的这一个，即存在，现在是定在并且进一步是存在者。
第二个同样是一个存在者，但被规定为某物的否定者，——一个他者。
某物作为生成乃是一种过渡，其环节本身也是某物，因此它就是变化；——一个已经具体化的生成。
——但某物起初只是在它的概念中才改变自身；它还没有被这样设定为中介着与被中介着的；起初它只是作为在其对自身的关系中单纯地保持自身的，以及它的否定作为同样具有质性的、毕竟只是一个他者。

en: a) Something and other; they are at first indifferent towards one another; an other is also an immediately determinate being, a something; the negation thus falls outside both.
Something is in itself against its being-for-other.
But the determinateness also belongs to its in-itself and is
zh: a) 某物与他者；它们起初彼此无关紧要；一个他者也是一个直接的存在者、一个某物；否定因而落在两者之外。
某物自在地与它的为他存在相对。
但规定性也属于它的自在，并且是

en: b) its determination, which passes just as much into property, which, identical with that, constitutes the immanent and at the same time negated being-for-other, the limit of something, which
zh: b) 它的规定，它同样过渡到性质，后者与前者相同，构成那内在的、同时又被否定的为他存在，构成某物的界限，

en: c) the immanent determination of something itself and thus something is the finite.
zh: c) 某物自身的内在规定，因而某物就是有限者。

en: In the first division, in which determinate being in general was considered, this had, as initially taken up, the determination of the existing.
The moments of its development, quality and something, are therefore likewise determinations of the affirmative.

In this division, on the contrary, the negative determination which lies in determinate being develops, which there was only negation in general, the first negation, but is now determined to the point of the being-in-itself of something, to the negation of negation.
zh: 在第一个部分中（那里考察了作为一般的定在），定在被接受进来时，最初具有了存在者的规定。
因此，它的展开的两个环节——质与某物——同样也是肯定的规定。
而在这一部分中发展着的，恰恰是处在定在之中的那个否定规定：它在那里还只是否定一般、第一个否定，而如今则被规定到某物的自身内存在、到否定之否定这一步。

en: Something and other are both first determinate being or something.
zh: 某物与他者两者首先都是存在者、都是某物。

en: Secondly, each is likewise an other.

It is indifferent which is called something first and merely on that account (in Latin, when they occur in a sentence, both are called aliud, or »one the other« alius alium; with mutuality the expression is alter alterum analog).
If we call a determinate being A and the other B, then B is to begin with determined as the other.
But A is just as much the other of B. Both are others in the same way.
To fix the distinction and the something to be taken affirmatively, one uses the expression »this«.
But this »this« says precisely that this distinguishing and singling out of the one something is a subjective designation which falls outside the something itself.
Into this external pointing falls the whole determinateness; even the expression »this« contains no distinction; all and every something are just as much these as they are also others.

One thinks to express through »this« something completely determinate; it is overlooked that the language, as the work of the understanding, expresses only the general, except in the name of a single object; but the individual name is a nonsense in the sense that it does not express a general, and appears as a mere conventional, arbitrary thing for the same reason as individual names can also be arbitrarily assumed, given or likewise changed.
zh: 其次，每一个同样也是一个他者。
哪一个先被称为某物、并且仅仅因为这一点而被如此称呼，都是无关紧要的（在拉丁文中，当二者出现在一个句子里时，两者都叫作 aliud，或者「一个与另一个」alius alium；在相互对置的情况下，相应的表达是 alter alterum）。
如果我们把一个定在叫做 A，把另一个叫做 B，那么首先 B 是作为他者而规定的。
但 A 同样也是 B. 的他者。两者同样地都是他者。
为了固定住差别以及那个应当被肯定地看待的某物，人们使用「这个」这一表述。
但「这个」这一表述恰好表明：这种对一个某物的区分与挑出，乃是一种主观的、落在某物之外的指称。
全部规定性都落入这种外在的指称之中；连「这个」这一表述本身也不包含任何差别；所有每一个某物同样都是「这个」，正如它们同样都是他者一样。
人们以为通过「这个」表达出某个完全被规定的东西；人们忽略了：语言作为知性的作品，只表达普遍者，只有在个别对象的名称中才例外；但个别名称在这个意义上是无意义的，因为它不表达任何普遍者；它之所以显得只是一种被规定的东西、一种任性的东西，也正是出于同样的理由：个别名称本来就可能被任意地采用、给予或同样地改变。

en: Thus otherness appears as a determination foreign to determinate being so determined, or the other outside the one determinate being; partly, that a determinate being is first determined as other by the comparison of a third, partly, that it is determined as other only for the sake of the other which is outside it, but is not so for itself.

At the same time, as has been remarked, every determinate being, also for representation, determines itself just as much as another determinate being, so that there does not remain a determinate being which is determined only as a determinate being, which would not be outside a determinate being, and thus would not itself be an other.
zh: 于是，他在表现为一种对于这样被规定的定在来说陌生的规定，或者说是处在这一个定在之外的他者：一方面，一个定在只有通过与第三者的比较才被规定为他者；另一方面，它只是为了那处在它之外的他者才被规定为他者，但就其自身而言并不是这样。
同时，如前所述，每一个定在——对表象来说也是如此——同样地规定为另一个定在，以至于不会留下这样一个定在：它仅仅被规定为一个定在，却不处在某个定在之外，因而它自身也不是一个他者。

en: Both are determined as something and as other, and thus are the same, and there is as yet no distinction between them.

But this sameness of the determinations likewise falls only into the external reflection, into the comparison of the two; but as the other is posited to begin with, so the same is indeed, for itself, in relation to the something, but also for itself outside it.
zh: 两者既被规定为某物、也被规定为他者，因此是同一个东西，而它们之间还没有任何差别。
但这种规定的同一性同样也只落入外在的反思、落入两者的比较之中；然而，正如他者首先被设定的那样，那个同一者就其自身而言固然处在与某物的关系中，但就其自身而言也在它之外。

en: Thirdly, therefore, the other is to be taken as isolated, in relation to itself; abstractly as the other; to heteron of the Platon, who opposes it to the one as one of the moments of the totality and thus ascribes to the other a nature of its own.
Thus the other, taken by itself alone, is not the other of something, but the other in itself, i.e. the other of itself.

– Such other according to its determination is physical nature; it is the other of spirit; this its determination is so to begin with a mere relativity, through which not a quality of nature itself but only a relation external to her is expressed; but since spirit is the true something and nature is therefore in herself only what she is against spirit, so, insofar as she is taken for herself, her quality is precisely this, to be the other in herself, the outside-self-being (in the determinations of space, time, matter).
zh: 第三，因此，他者应当被当作孤立地、就其自身的关系来把握；抽象地把握为他者；即柏拉图的那个「异者」，他把他者与一者相对立、作为总体性的诸环节之一，从而给他者以自己的本性。
这样一来，单独地就其自身把握的他者，就不是某物的他者，而是它自身的他者，即它自己的他者。
——这样按其规定而成为他者的就是物理自然；它是精神的他者；它的这一规定起初只是一种单纯的相关性，通过它所表达的不是自然自身的质，而只是一种对自然来说外在的关系；但既然精神才是真正的某物，而自然因此在它自身上只是它相对于精神所是的东西，那么，就其自身被把握而言，自然的质恰恰就是：在自身中是他者、是那个在自身之外的存在（在空间、时间、物质的诸规定中）。

en: The other for itself is the other in itself, hence the other of itself, thus the other of the other, – hence the altogether unequal in itself, the self-negating, the self-changing.

But likewise it remains identical with itself, for that into which it changed itself is the other, which otherwise has no further determination; but the self-changing is determined to be an other not in a different way, but in the same way; it therefore agrees with itself in the same.

Thus it is posited as reflected into itself with the sublation of otherness, as a something identical with itself, from which otherness, which is at the same time a moment of it, is a distinct one which does not accrue to it as something itself.
zh: 自在的他者就是在自身的他者，因而是自己的他者，即他者的他者，——所以是在自身中彻底不等同的、自我否定的、自我改变着的。
但同样它也与自己同一，因为那个它所变入的东西就是他者，而他在别的方面并没有更多规定；而自我改变者被规定为以同样而非别的方式成为一个他者；因此它在同一个东西中与自身相合。
于是它被设定为在扬弃他在的同时向自身反思着的东西，即与自己同一的某物；而他在同时又是它的环节，它是一个有别的东西，并不作为某物自身归属于它。

en: Something maintains itself in its non-existence; it is essentially one with it and essentially not one with it.
It therefore stands in relation to its otherness; it is not purely its otherness.
Otherness is at the same time contained in it and at the same time still separated from it; it is being-for-other.
zh: 某物在它的非定在中保持自身；它本质上与它合一，也本质上不与它合一。
因此它处在与它的他在的关系中；它并不纯粹就是它的他在。
他在同时被包含在它之中，同时又仍然与它分离开来；它就是为他存在。

en: Determinate being as such is the immediate, the relationless; or it is in the determination of being.

But determinate being, as containing non-being in itself, is determinate being, negated in itself, and then to begin with an other, – but because it maintains itself at the same time in its negation, it is only being-for-other.
zh: 作为这样的定在是直接者、是无关系者；或者说，它处在存在的规定中。
但定在由于把非存在包含在自身之内，就是那在自身中被否定了的规定了的存在，并且首先是他者，——但因为它同时在自己的否定中保持自身，所以它就只是为他存在。

en: It maintains itself in its non-existence and is being, but not being in general, but as relation to itself against its relation to the other, as equality with itself against its inequality.
Such a being is being-in-itself.
zh: 它在它的非定在中保持自身并且是存在，但不是一般意义上的存在，而是作为对自身的关系、相对于它对他者的关系，作为与自身的等同、相对于自身的不等同。
这样的存在就是自在存在。

en: Being-for-other and being-in-itself make up the two moments of something.
There are two pairs of determinations that occur here: 1.
something and other; 2.
being-for-other and being-in-itself.
The former contain the relationlessness of their determinateness; something and other fall apart.

But their truth is their relation; being-for-other and being-in-itself are therefore posited as those determinations as moments of one and the same, as determinations which are relations and remain in their unity, in the unity of determinate being.
Each one thus also contains in itself at the same time its moment which is different from it.
zh: 为他存在与自在存在构成某物的两个环节。
这里出现的是两对规定：1.
某物与他者；2.
为他存在与自在存在。
前一对包含着其规定性的无关系性；某物与他者彼此分离。
但它们的真理就是它们的关系；因此为他存在与自在存在被设定为同一个东西的环节，被设定为那些作为关系而存在并在它们的统一中、在定在的统一中保持着的规定。
这样，每一个自身同时也就包含着那个与它有别的环节。

en: Being and nothing in their unity, which is determinate being, are no longer as being and nothing, – they are so only outside their unity; thus in their uneasy unity, in becoming, they are coming-to-be and perishing.
– Being in something is being-in-itself.
Being, the relation to itself, the equality with itself, is now no longer immediate, but a relation to itself only as non-being of otherness (as determinate being reflected into itself).

– Likewise non-being as the moment of something in this unity of being and non-being is not non-existence in general, but other and, determined according to the distinction of being from it, at the same time a relation to its non-existence, being-for-other.
zh: 存在与无在它们的统一中（这统一就是定在）不再作为存在与无，——它们只是在它们的统一之外才如此；这样，在它们不安的统一中、在生成中，它们就是产生与消逝。
——某物中的存在就是自在存在。
存在，即对自身的关系、与自身的等同，如今不再是直接者，而只是作为他在的非存在（作为向自身反思着的定在）的对自身的关系。
——同样，非存在作为某物的环节，在存在与非存在的这一统一中，并非一般意义上的非定在，而是他者，并且按照存在与它的区别被规定为同时是对它的非存在的关系，即为他存在。

en: Thus being-in-itself is firstly the negative relation to non-existence, it has otherness outside it and is opposed to it: insofar as something is in itself, it is withdrawn from otherness and from being-for-other.
But secondly it has non-being itself as well; for it itself is the non-being of being-for-other.
zh: 因此，自在存在首先是对非定在的否定关系，它把他在置于自己之外并与之相对：某物自在地是，就此而言它是从他在和为他存在中撤离出来的。
但其次，它自身也具有非存在；因为它自身就是为他存在的非存在。

en: Being-for-other, however, is firstly the negation of the simple relation of being to itself, which is to be determinate being and something; insofar as something is in an other or for an other, it lacks its own being.

But secondly it is not the non-existence as pure nothing; it is a non-existence which points to the being-in-itself as to its being reflected into itself, as conversely the being-in-itself points to the being-for-other.
zh: 然而，为他存在首先是否定存在对自身的那个单纯关系，而那个关系应当是定在和某物；某物在某个他者之中、或为某个他者而在的范围内，就缺少它自己的存在。
但其次，它不是作为纯粹的无的非定在；它是一种非定在，它指向自在存在、把它看作向自身反思着的存在，正如反过来自在存在也指向为他存在一样。

en: Both moments are determinations of one and the same, namely of something.
In-itself is something insofar as, from being-for-other, it has returned into itself.
Something also has, however, a determination or circumstance in itself (here the accent falls on in) or in itself, insofar as this circumstance is external to it, a being-for-other.
zh: 两个环节都是同一个东西的规定，即某物的规定。
自在就是某物，就它从为他存在中返回到自身之中而言。
然而，某物自身还具有一个规定或情形（这里重音落在「自身」上），或者就这种情形在它之外而言、就这种情形是为他存在而言。

en: This leads to a further determination.

Being-in-itself and being-for-other are to begin with different; but that something is the same as what it is in itself, also has in itself, and conversely what it is as being-for-other, also is in itself, – this is the identity of being-in-itself and being-for-other, according to the determination that something itself is one and the same both moments, that they are thus undivided in it.

– Formally this identity already results in the sphere of determinate being, but more expressly in the consideration of essence and then of the relation of inwardness and externality, and most determinately in the consideration of the idea as the unity of concept and actuality.

– One thinks to say something lofty with the in-itself, as with the inward; but what something only is in itself is also only in itself; »in itself« is only an abstract, and thereby itself external, determination.
The expressions »there is nothing in it« or »there is something in it« contain, though somewhat obscurely, that what is in a thing also belongs to its being-in-itself, to its inner true worth.
zh: 这就导向一个进一步的规定。
自在存在与为他存在起初是有差别的；但某物自在地是什么，它自身也就具有它，反过来，它作为为他存在是什么，它自在地也是什么，——这一点就是自在存在与为他存在的同一性，其规定在于：某物自身是这两个环节的同一个东西，因而它们在它之中是不可分离的。
——形式上，这一同一性在定在的领域之中就已经产生出来了；但在对本质、以及随后对内在性与外在性的关系的考察中更为明确；而在对观念作为概念与现实性的统一这一考察中则最为确定。
——人们以为用「自在」说出某种高尚的东西，就像用「内在」一样；但某物仅仅自在地是什么，它就仅仅自在地是；「自在」只是一种抽象的、因而是自身在外的规定。
「它里面没有东西」或「它里面有东西」这些说法，较为晦暗地包含着这样一点：一个东西里所具有的，同样属于它的自在存在，属于它内在的真实价值。

en: It may be remarked that here the sense of the thing-in-itself emerges, which is a very simple abstraction, but for a time a very important determination, as it were something noble, just as the proposition that we do not know what things are in themselves was a many-sided maxim.
– Things are called in-themselves in so far as all being-for-other is abstracted from them, that is, in general, in so far as they are thought without any determination, as non-things.
In this sense, of course, one cannot know what the thing-in-itself is.

For the question What? requires that determinations be given; but since the things of which they would have to be given are at the same time to be things-in-themselves, that is, precisely without determination, the impossibility of answering is thoughtlessly built into the question, or one gives only a nonsensical answer.
– The thing-in-itself is the same as that Absolute of which one knows nothing except that everything is one in it.
One therefore knows very well what is in these things-in-themselves; as such they are nothing but truthless, empty abstractions.

What, however, the thing-in-itself is in truth, what is truly in itself, of this logic is the exposition; but by in-itself something better than abstraction is understood, namely what a thing is in its concept; this concept, however, is concrete in itself, comprehensible as concept in general, and recognizable in itself as determined and as the connection of its determinations.
zh: 这里可以指出：自在之物的意义在此显露出来；自在之物乃是一种极为单纯的抽象，但在有一段时间里它却是一个极为重要的规定、几乎可以说是某种高贵的规定——正如「我们不知道事物自在地是什么」这一命题曾是一句多义的格言。
——事物之所以被称作自在的，是因为人们从它们那里撇开了一切为他存在，也就是说撇开了一切规定，把它们思想为无规定者、即思想为非存在者。
当然，在这种意义上人们无法知道自在之物是什么。
因为「是什么？」这一问题要求给出规定；但既然要求给出规定的那个事物同时又应当是自在之物——也就是恰恰没有规定——那么，不加思索地，这一问题里就已经蕴含了无法回答的不可能性；或者，人们给出的不过是一个不合常理的回答。
——自在之物就同那个绝对者是一回事，关于他人们除了知道「一切在他之中是一」之外一无所知。
因此人们很清楚地知道，这些自在之物里包含着什么；作为自在之物，它们不过是无真理的、空洞的抽象。
然而自在之物在真理中是什么、真正自在地是什么，逻辑学就是这一点的展示；不过这里在「自在」之下所理解的不只是抽象，而是比抽象更好的东西，即某物在其概念中是什么；而这个概念本身在内部是具体的，作为概念一般地是可以把握的，并且在自身中可以被把握为：它是被规定着的，同时也是其诸规定的联接。

en: Being-in-itself has to begin with being-for-other as its opposite moment; but being-posited is also opposed to it; this expression indeed also contains being-for-other, but it definitely contains the already accomplished turning back of what is not in itself into what its being-in-itself is, in which it is positive.

Being-in-itself is ordinarily taken as an abstract way of expressing the concept; positing properly belongs only to the sphere of essence, of objective reflection; the ground posits that which is grounded through it; the cause still more brings forth an effect, a determinate being whose independence is immediately negated and which has in itself the sense of having its thing, its being, in another.

In the sphere of being, determinate being only emerges from becoming; or with the something an other is posited, with the finite the infinite, but the finite does not bring forth the infinite, does not posite it.

In the sphere of being, the self-determining of the concept itself is at first only in itself, – it is what is called a passing-over; even the reflecting determinations of being, such as something and other or the finite and the infinite, whether they essentially point to one another or are being-for-other, count as qualitative and existing for themselves; the other is, the finite counts just as much as immediately being and standing by itself as the infinite; their sense appears as complete even without their other.

The positive and the negative, on the contrary, cause and effect, even insofar as they are taken as existing in isolation, at the same time have no sense without one another; there is present in them themselves their appearing in one another, the appearing of their other in each.

– In the various circles of determination and especially in the progress of the exposition, or more closely in the progress of the concept towards its exposition, it is a principal thing always to distinguish well what is still in itself and what is posited, how the determinations are as being in the concept and how they are as posited or as being-for-other.

This is a distinction which belongs only to dialectical development and of which metaphysical philosophizing, among which the critical belongs, knows nothing; the definitions of metaphysics as well as its assumptions, distinctions and inferences want only to assert and bring forth something being, and indeed being-in-itself.
zh: 自在存在起初把为他存在当作与它相对的那个环节；但被设定者也被置于与它相对的地位；这一表述固然同样包含为他存在，但它确切地包含着那种已经发生的回转，即把那自在地不是者的东西折回到它的自在存在，在其中它是肯定者。
自在存在通常被当作表达概念的一种抽象方式来对待；设定其实首先属于本质、客观反思的领域；根据设定那通过它而获得根据的东西；原因则更进一步地产生出一个效果、一个其独立自主被直接否定掉的定在，它自身带着这样的意义：它的东西、它的存在，乃是在一个他者之中。
在存在的领域里，定在不过是从生成中走出来；或者说，在某物旁边设定了一个他者，在有限者旁边设定了无限者，但有限者并不产生无限者，也不设定它。
在存在的领域里，概念自身的自我规定起初还只是自在的——人们正是把这称作一种过渡；甚至存在那些反思性的规定，如某物与他者、有限者与无限者，无论它们本质上是否彼此指向、或者是否就是为他存在，都仍旧作为质的规定、作为自为存在者而成立；他者存在着，有限者与无限者一样，同样被看作直接存在的、自身稳定的；即使没有他者，它们的意义也显得是完满的。
相反，肯定与否定、原因与效果，即使它们被当作孤立地存在着的，也同时没有彼此便没有意义；在它们自身中就有它们的相互显现，即每一个之中都有其自身他者的显现。
——在规定的不同圆圈中，特别是在阐述的推进中、更确切地说在概念向其阐述的推进中，主要的事情始终在于好好地区分：什么还只是自在的、什么是已被设定的；这些规定作为在概念中的规定是什么样的，以及它们作为被设定者、作为为他存在者又是什么样的。
这是一个只属于辩证发展的差别，形而上学的哲学思考——批判哲学也属于其中——并不认识它；形而上学的定义以及它的预设、区别与推论，只想断言并产生出存在者、而且是自在存在者。

en: Being-for-other, in the unity of the something with itself, is identical with its in-itself – thus being-for-other is present in the something.
The determinateness thus reflected into itself is thereby again simple being, thus again a quality, – the determination.
zh: 为他存在在某物与自身的统一中就与它的自在相同一——这样，为他存在便在某物那里。
这样在自身中反思着的规定性于是又成为单纯的存在，因而又是质——即规定。

en: The in-itself into which the something is reflected into itself from its being-for-other is no longer abstract in-itself, but, as the negation of its being-for-other, mediated through this, which is thus its moment.

It is not only the immediate identity of the something with itself, but the identity through which the something is in itself what it is in itself; being-for-other is present in it because the in-itself is the sublation of the same and is in itself out of the same; but just as much already, because it is abstract, hence essentially affected with negation, with being-for-other.
Here what is present is not only quality and reality, being determinateness, but being-in-itself determinateness, and the development is to posit it as this determinateness reflected into itself.
zh: 某物从它的为他存在反思回自身之中而到的那个自在，不再是抽象的自在，而是作为它的为他存在的否定、通过这个为他存在得到中介，而后者正是它的环节。
这不仅是某物与自身的直接同一性，而且是那种同一性：某物自在地是什么，它在自身中也是什么；为他存在在它身上，因为自在正是对同一个为他存在的扬弃，并从这同一个为他存在反思回自身之中；但同样也早就是这样，因为它是抽象的，因而本质上带着否定、带着为他存在。
这里存在的并不只是质与实在性、即存在的规定性，而是自在存在的规定性；而发展就是把它设定为这种在自身中反思着的规定性。

en: The quality which the in-itself is in the simple something essentially in unity with the something’s other moment, its being-at-it, may be called its determination, in so far as this word is distinguished in the more precise sense from determinateness in general.

Determination is affirmative determinateness as being-in-itself, to which the something remains conformant in its determinate being against its entanglement with the other, of which it would be determined, maintains itself in its equality with itself and makes it valid in its being-for-other.
It fulfils its determination in so far as the further determinateness, which first grows manifold through its behaviour towards the other, becomes its fullness in accordance with its being-in-itself.
Determination contains this: that what a thing is in itself, it is also in itself.
zh: 质——自在在单纯的某物中本质上与该某物的另一个环节即在他那里的存在相统一——可以被称作它的规定，只要这个词在更确切的意义上与规定性一般相区别。
规定是作为自在存在的肯定的规定性：某物在其定在中相对于它与他者的纠缠——它本应由这个他者得到规定——始终与这个自在存在相合，在与自身的等同中保持自身，并在它的为他存在中使它生效。
它实现自己的规定，只要那进一步的规定性——它首先通过对他者的态度而多方面地生长——依照它的自在存在而成为它的充盈。
规定包含着这一点：某物自在地是什么，它自在地也在自身之中。

en: The determination of man is thinking reason: thinking as such is his simple determinateness, it is by this that he is distinguished from the animal; he is thinking in itself in so far as this is also distinguished from his being-for-other, his own naturalness and sensuousness, by virtue of which he is immediately connected with the other.

But thinking is also in itself in man; man himself is thinking, he is there as thinking, it is his existence and actuality; and further, in so far as it is in his determinate being and his determinate being is in thinking, it is concrete, it is to be taken with content and fulfilment, it is thinking reason, and so it is the determination of man.

But even this determination is again only in itself as an ought, i.e. it with the fulfilment which is incorporated into its in-itself, in the form of the in-itself as such against the determinate being not incorporated into it, which at the same time still is external, immediately opposed sensuousness and nature.
zh: 人的规定是能思的理性：思维一般来说是他的单纯的规定性，他正是借此与动物相区别；就思维同样区别于他的为他存在、区别于他自己的自然性与感性——他正是凭借后者而直接地与一个他者相联系——而言，他自在地是思维。
但思维也在人之中自在着；人本身就是思维，他作为能思者而在那里；思维就是他的存在与现实性；而且更进一步，就它在他的定在中、而他的定在又在于思维之中而言，思维是具体的，应当连同内容与实现一道来取；它就是能思的理性，如此它就是人的规定。
但连这一规定本身也只是自在地作为一个应然；也就是说，它是连同那被纳入其自在之中的实现、在自在一般的形式下，与那个未被纳入其中的定在相对立，而这个定在同时还作为外在的、直接与它相对而立的感性和自然。

en: The fulfilment of being-in-itself with determinateness is also distinguished from the determinateness which is only being-for-other and remains outside determination.
For in the field of the qualitative, even the immediate, qualitative being remains opposed to the distinctions in their being-sublated.

What the something has in itself divides itself in this way and is on this side external determinate being of the something, which is also its determinate being, but does not belong to its being-in-itself.
– Determinateness is thus constitution.
zh: 自在存在以规定性得到的实现，也区别于那种只是为他存在、并且保持在规定之外的规定性。
因为在质的领域里，甚至那直接的、质的存在也仍然与那些在被扬弃状态中的差别相对立。
某物自在地具有的东西就这样分开了，并且就这一面而言是某物的外在的定在，它也就是某物的定在，但并不属于它的自在存在。
——规定性于是就是性质。

en: Something is of such or other constitution insofar as it is comprehended in external influence and relations.
This external relation on which the constitution depends, and the being-determined through an other, appears as something accidental.
But it is a quality of the something to be given up to this externality and to have a constitution.
zh: 某物或如此或别样地具有性质，就它被包含在外在的影响与关系之中而言。
这种外在的关系——性质依赖于它——以及通过一个他者而受到规定这件事，显得是某种偶然者。
但某物听任于这种外在性并具有一种性质，这乃是它的质。

en: Insofar as something changes itself, the change falls into the constitution; it is on the something what an other becomes.
It itself maintains itself in the change which touches only this unsettled surface of its otherness, not its determination.
zh: 就某物自身发生变化而言，这一变化便落入性质之中；它是在某物身上一个他者所成为的东西。
它自身在变化中保持自身，而这一变化所触及的只是它的他在的那层不安定的表面，并不是它的规定。

en: Determination and constitution are thus distinguished from each other; something is indifferent to its constitution in respect of its determination.
What, however, something has in itself is the middle which binds the two together in this syllogism.
Being-at-something, however, rather showed itself as falling apart into those two extremes.
The simple middle is determinateness as such; both determination and constitution belong to its identity.
But determination passes over of itself into constitution, and this into that.

This lies in what has been said so far; the connection is closer this one: insofar as what something is in itself is also in itself, it is affected with being-for-other; determination is thereby as such open to the relation to the other.

Determinateness is at the same time a moment, but at the same time contains the qualitative distinction, different from being-in-itself, the negative of the something, the being of another determinate being.
The determinateness which thus comprehends the other in itself, united with being-in-itself, brings otherness into being-in-itself or into determination, which is thereby reduced to constitution.

– Conversely, being-for-other, isolated and posited for itself as constitution, is on it the same as the other as such, the other in itself, i.e. of itself; but so it is a determinate being relating to itself, so being-in-itself with a determinateness, thus determination.

– It follows from this that, insofar as the two are also to be kept apart, constitution, which appears to be grounded in something external, in an other in general, also depends on determination, and the alien determining is at the same time determined through the own, immanent determining of the something.
But further, constitution belongs to what the something is in itself: with its constitution something changes.
zh: 规定与性质于是彼此有别；某物就其规定而言，对它的性质是无关紧要的。
而某物自在地具有的东西，就是这个推论中把二者联结起来的中项。
而在某物之中的存在倒显得是分解为那两个极端。
单纯的中项就是规定性本身；规定与性质两者都属于它的同一性。
但规定自在地过渡到性质，而性质又过渡回规定。
这一点包含在此前所说的内容里；更确切地说，其联系是：就某物自在地是什么、它自在地也在自身中而言，它便带着为他存在；因此规定本身敞开于与他者的关系。
规定性同时是一个环节，但它同时又包含着那个质地上的差别，即不同于自在存在的差别、某物的否定，即成为另一个定在。
这样把那个他者包含在自身之中的规定性，与自在存在相统一，就把他在带入自在存在之中、或者带入规定之中，而规定由此被降格为性质。
——反过来，为他存在一旦作为性质被孤立起来、被设定为自为的，它在它身上就与那个他者（作为自在的他者，即他自身的他者）是一回事；但这样它就是那种对自身关系着的定在，就是带有规定性的自在存在，亦即规定。
——由此可知，就二者仍须彼此分开而言，那显得植根于外在者、植根于一个他者一般的性质，同样也依赖于规定；而外来的规定作用同时又通过某物自身的、内在的规定而得到规定。
但此外，性质属于某物自在地所是的东西：随着它的性质如何，某物也就变化了。

en: This change of the something is no longer the first change of the something merely in accordance with its being-for-other; that first one was only the change existing in itself, belonging to the inner concept; the change is now also the one posited in the something.
– The something itself is further determined, and negation is posited as immanent in it, as its developed being-in-itself.
zh: 某物的这一变化不再是某物仅仅依其为他存在而有的那种第一变化；那第一个变化只是自在地存在的变化，属于内在的概念；而如今这一变化同时也是设定在某物身上的变化。
——某物自身得到了进一步的规定，否定则作为内在于它的东西被设定起来，作为它发展了的自身内存在。

en: To begin with, the passing-over of determination and constitution into one another is the sublation of their distinction; thereby determinate being or something in general is posited, and in so far as it results from that distinction which also comprehends the qualitative otherness in itself, there are two somethings, but not merely others in general opposed to one another, so that this negation would still be abstract and fall only into comparison, but it is now immanent in the somethings.

They are indifferent to one another as existing, but this their affirmation is no longer immediate; each relates to itself by means of the sublation of otherness, which is reflected in the determination into being-in-itself.
zh: 首先，规定与性质彼此之间的过渡就是它们之差别的扬弃；这样，某物或某物一般就被设定下来了；而由于它出自那个同样把质上的他在包含在自身之中的差别，此时有了两个某物，而不只是彼此相对的他者一般——以致这一否定本来还只是抽象的、只落入比较之中——但它如今内在于诸某物。
它们作为存在者是彼此无关紧要的，但它们这一肯定已不再是直接的了；每一个都借助对他在的扬弃而与自身相关，而这个他在在规定之中被反思回自在存在。

en: Something relates to the other thus of itself because otherness is posited in it as its own moment; its being-in-itself comprehends negation in itself, and by virtue of this it now has its affirmative determinate being.
But from this the other is also qualitatively distinguished; it is thereby posited outside the something.
The negation of its other is only the quality of the something, for as this sublation of its other it is something.

Only thereby does the other properly stand opposed to a determinate being itself; to the first something the other is only externally opposed; or rather, since in truth they are connected purely, i.e. according to their concept, their connection is this: that determinate being has passed over into otherness, something into other.
Something is an other as much as the other is.

Insofar now the being-in-itself is the non-being of otherness, which is contained in it but at the same time distinguished as being, the something itself is the negation, the ceasing of an other at it; it is posited as negatively relating to this and thereby maintaining itself; – this other, the being-in-itself of the something as the negation of the negation, is its being-in-itself, and at the same time this sublation is present in it as simple negation, namely as its negation of the other something external to it.

It is a determinateness of the same which is identical both with the being-in-itself of the somethings, as the negation of the negation, and also, since these negations are other somethings opposed to one another, concludes them from themselves and likewise separates them from one another, each negating the other, – the limit.
zh: 某物之所以从自身出发这样地与他者相关，是因为他在被设定在它之中作为它自己的环节；它的自身内存在把否定包含在自身之中，并且正是凭借这一否定，它如今才有了自己肯定性的定在。
但他者就此也在质地上与它有别；这样他者就被设定在某物之外了。
对它的他者的否定不过是某物的质，因为正作为对他者的这一扬弃，它才是某物。
只有这样，那个他者才真正地与一个定在本身相对立；对第一个某物而言，他者只是外在的；但如果说它们在事实上纯然地、亦即按照其概念彼此联系着，那么它们的联系就是：定在过渡到他在，某物过渡到他者。
某物之为他者，正如他者之为他者。
就自身内存在是他者的非存在而言——这个他在包含于其中，但同时又被区别为存在者——某物自身就是否定、就是在他者身上的终止；它被设定为对这个他者持否定态度、并由此保持自身。——这个他者，即作为否定之否定的某物的自身内存在，就是他的自在存在；同时这一扬弃在他身上作为单纯否定而存在，也就是作为它对那个外在于他的另一个某物的否定。
这是同一者的一种规定性：它既与诸某物的自身内存在相同一、作为否定之否定，又由于这些否定作为彼此相对的其他某物，就既从它们自身出发把它们括在一起、也同样地把它们彼此分开，每一个都否定另一个——这就是界限。

en: Being-for-other is the undetermined, affirmative community of something with its other; in the limit there emerges the non-being – the non-being-for-other –, the qualitative negation of the other, which is thereby held off from the something reflected into itself.
The development of this concept is to be seen, but it rather shows itself as entanglement and contradiction.

This is at once present in the fact that the limit, as the negation of the something reflected into itself, contains in itself ideally the moments of the something and of the other, and these as distinguished moments are at the same time posited in the sphere of determinate being as real, qualitatively distinguished.
zh: 为他存在是某物与它的他者之间未经规定的、肯定性的共同性；在界限中浮现出非存在——即不为他存在——也就是他者那质上的否定，而由此他者被挡在那个反思回自身之中的某物之外。
这一概念的发展是可以看到的，但它毋宁表现为纠缠与矛盾。
这一点当下就存在于：界限作为反思回自身的某物的否定，在其自身中观念性地包含着某物与他者的诸环节；而这些作为有差别的环节同时在定在的领域中被设定为实在的、质地上有差别的。

en: α) Something is thus immediate determinate being relating to itself and has a limit to begin with as against the other: it is the non-being of the other, not of the something itself; it limits its other in it.

– But the other is itself a something in general; the limit, then, which the something has against the other, is also the limit of the other as something, the limit of it by which it holds the first something off from itself as its other, or is a non-being of that something; so it is not only the non-being of the other, but of the one as well as of the other something, thus of something in general.
zh: α) 因此某物是那种直接地与自身相关的定在，并且起初有一个针对他者的界限：这界限是他者的非存在，而不是某物自身的非存在；某物在界限中限定自己的他者。
——但他者本身也是一个某物一般；因此，某物针对他者而有的那个界限，同时也是他者作为某物的界限，即他借以把第一个某物作为自己的他者挡在自己之外的界限，或者说就是那个某物的非存在；所以它不仅是他者的非存在，而且是一个某物与另一个某物的非存在，因而是某物一般的非存在。

en: But essentially it is just as much the non-being of the other; so something is at the same time through its limit.

Insofar as something is limiting, it is indeed reduced to being limited itself; but its limit, as the ceasing of the other at it, is at the same time itself only the being of the something; the latter is through it what it is, has in it its quality.

– This relation is the external appearance of the fact that the limit is simple negation or the first negation, but the other is at the same time the negation of the negation, the being-in-itself of the something.
zh: 但在本质上它同样是他者的非存在；因此，某物同时便是通过其界限而存在着的。
就某物是限定者而言，它固然因此被降低为自身也受到限定；但它的界限，作为他者在它身上的终止，同时本身又只是某物的存在；某物正是凭借界限而成为它所是的东西，并在界限中具有它的质。
——这种关系是下述事实的外在现象：界限是单纯否定、或者说第一个否定，而他者同时却是否定之否定，即某物的自身内存在。

en: Something is therefore, as immediate determinate being, the limit against other something, but it has it in itself and is something through the mediation of it, which is just as much its non-being.
It is the mediation through which something and other both is and is not.
zh: 因此，某物作为直接的定在，乃是针对另一个某物的界限；但它把这界限保持在自身之中，并且正是通过这界限的中介才是某物，而这中介同样就是它的非存在。
它就是那使某物与他者既存在又不存在的中介。

en: β) Insofar now something is in its limit and is not, and these moments are an immediate, qualitative difference, the non-existence and the determinate being of the something fall outside one another.
Something has its determinate being outside (or, however one may represent it, within) its limit; likewise the other, because it is something, is outside the same.
It is the middle between the two, in which they cease.
They have determinate being beyond one another and beyond their limit; the limit as the non-being of each is the other of both.
zh: β) 因此，就某物在其界限中而又不在其界限中、并且这些环节构成一个直接的质上的差别而言，某物的非定在与定在便彼此外在。
某物把它的定在保持在它的界限之外（或者，无论人们怎样表象它，都在界限之内）；同样，他者因为是某物，也在这界限之外。
它是二者之间的中项，在它之中二者终止。
它们在彼此之外、也在它们的界限之外拥有定在；界限作为每一个的非存在，就是二者共同的他者。

en: According to this difference of the something from its limit, the line appears as line only outside its limit, of the point; the surface as surface outside the line; the body as body only outside its limiting surface.
– This is the side from which the limit first falls into representation – the being-outside-itself of the concept – and it is taken above all also in spatial objects.
zh: 按照某物与其界限的这种相异，作为线的线只出现在其界限、即点的之外；作为面的面出现在线的之外；作为物体的物体只出现在那限定它的面之外。
——这正是界限首先落入表象——概念的外在化——的那一面，而人们首先也主要是在空间对象上这样看待界限。

en: γ) Further, however, the something, insofar as it is outside the limit, the unbounded something, is only determinate being in general.

So it is not distinguished from its other; it is only determinate being, and so has the same determination as its other; each is only something in general, or each is other; the two are thus the same.
But this their initially immediate determinate being is now posited with determinateness as limit, in which both are what they are, distinguished from one another.
But it is just as much their common difference, the unity and difference of the same, as the determinate being.

This double identity of the two, determinate being and limit, contains this: that the something has its determinate being only in the limit, and that, since the limit and the immediate determinate being are at the same time the negative of one another, the something, which is only in its limit, just as much separates itself from itself and points beyond itself to its non-being, and declares this as its being, and so passes over into the same.
To apply this to the preceding example, the one determination is that something is what it is only in its limit.

– So the point is not only a limit of the line in that the line only ceases in it and is as determinate being outside it, – the line is not only a limit of the surface in that the surface only ceases in the line, likewise the surface as limit of the body.

Rather, in the point the line also begins; it is its absolute beginning; even insofar as it is represented as unbounded on both its sides or, as one says, extended into the infinite, the point makes up its element, as the line makes up the element of the surface, the surface that of the body.
These limits are the principle of that which they limit; as the one, for example, is a limit as the hundredth, but also an element of the whole hundred.
zh: γ) 此外，某物就它在界限之外而言、即那无界限的某物而言，只是定在一般而已。
这样，它就与它的他者没有差别；它只是定在，因而与它的他者有着同样的规定；每一个都只是某物一般，或者说每一个都是他者；二者如此就是同一个东西。
但它们起初这直接的定在，如今却以「规定性即界限」的方式被设定下来，在界限中二者各自是其所是、并且彼此有别。
但界限同样也是它们的共同差别，即二者的统一与差别，正如定在一样。
二者——定在与界限——的这一双重同一性包含着这一点：某物只在界限中才有它的定在；而且，就界限与直接的定在同时互为否定而言，那个只在自身界限中的某物同样地把自己从自身中分离出来，越过自身而指向自己的非存在，并把这一点宣示为自己的存在，于是过渡到同一个东西之中。
把这一点应用到前面的例子上，其一项规定就是：某物只在它的界限中才是它所是的东西。
——因此，点并不只是线的界限（线在点中终止、作为定在而在点之外），线也不只是面的界限（面在线中终止），面同样也是物体的界限。
相反，线同样是在点中开始的；点是线的绝对开端；即使线被表象为在它的两侧都无界限、或者如人们所说的那样被表象为向无限延伸，点仍构成线的元素，正如线构成面的元素、面构成物体的元素一样。
这些界限乃是它们所限定者的原则；例如「一」作为百分之一乃是界限，但同时又是整个一百的元素。

en: The other determination is the unrest of the something in its limit, in which it is immanent, the contradiction to be which it sends itself beyond itself.
So the point is this dialectic of itself, to become the line; the line the dialectic of becoming the surface; the surface the dialectic of becoming the total space.
A second definition of line, surface and entire space is given in such a way that through the movement of the point the line arises, through the movement of the line the surface arises, and so on.
This movement of the point, of the line and so on is, however, regarded as something accidental or as merely something represented.

This is, however, properly taken back in the fact that the determinations from which the line and so on are to arise are their elements and principles, and these are nothing other than at the same time their limits; the becoming is thus not regarded as accidental or as merely represented.

That point, line and surface are for themselves, self-contradictory, beginnings which thrust themselves away from themselves, and that the point thus passes over from itself through its concept into the line, moves in itself and makes it arise, and so on, – lies in the concept of the limit immanent in the something.

The application itself, however, belongs to the consideration of space; to indicate it here: the point is the wholly abstract limit, but in a determinate being, and this is still taken quite indeterminate; it is the so-called absolute, i.e. abstract space, the purely continuous being-outside-one-another.

By the fact that the limit is not abstract negation, but in this determinate being that it is spatial determinateness, the point is spatial, the contradiction of the abstract negation and of continuity, and thereby the passing-over and the being-passed-over into line and so on, as indeed there is no point, and neither a line nor a surface.
zh: 另一项规定是某物在其界限中的不安，在界限中它内在地就是那个把自己派遣到自身之外的矛盾。
所以点就是它自身要成为线的这种辩证法，线就是成为面的辩证法，面就是成为总体空间的辩证法。
对线、面与整个空间的第二种定义是这样给出的：通过点的运动产生线，通过线的运动产生面，如此等等。
然而，点、线等等的这种运动却被看作某种偶然者，或者仅仅是被表象出来的东西。
然而，这一点其实已被收回到这样一点之中：那些线等等应当由之产生的规定乃是它们的元素与原则，而这些元素与原则同时又正是它们的界限；如此，产生就不再被看作偶然的、或仅仅是被表象出来的。
点、线、面乃是自在的、自相矛盾的开端，它们把自己从自身推开；而点因而从自身出发通过其概念过渡到线，在自身中运动并使线产生出来，如此等等——这一点就蕴涵在那个内在于某物的界限的概念之中。
不过这一应用本身属于对空间的考察；在此只把它指出来：点是全然抽象的界限，但处在一种定在之中，而这种定在这里还完全未被规定；它就是所谓绝对的、亦即抽象的空间，即纯然连续的彼此外在。
由于界限并不是抽象的否定，而是在这一它作为空间的规定性而存在的定在之中，点才是空间的，才是抽象否定与连续性的矛盾，因而才是向线等等的过渡与已过渡；正如确实并没有点，也并没有线和面一样。

en: Something posited with its immanent limit as the contradiction of itself, through which it is pointed and driven beyond itself, is the finite.
zh: 某物连同其内在的界限一起被设定为它自身的矛盾，并通过这一矛盾被指向、被驱赶到自身之外，这就是有限者。
